text:
I love First Watch! My favorites are the Baja turkey burger, veggie burger and well pretty much ANY thing on the menu! The great service makes the dining experience perfect!
Go and get you $20 bonus gift card when you purchase $100 worth of gift cards

The juices were good but when we went in, there were 2 employees working behind a counter with no masks on. They didn't even have it on their chin, just completely disregarded the mask mandate even though there were 4 costumers in the store. My friend and I felt really unsafe and wanted to leave as soon as possible.
Best eggs Benedict! And great prices! They also do great salads! I really hope that they reopen soon!

Last night 01/31 around 11:30, I went to doordash at the Burlington NJ Wendys on Mount Holly Rd. While I was at the window trying to place my doordash orders (2 of them), the night shift supervisor refused to allow me to place the separate orders for my customers. I accepted to put them on one tab, but the doordash card got declined because I can't combine orders. After I asked him to just separate them, he said I have to get back in line and refused service to me. As he cursed through the window, he refused to give any names of him or the general manager. I would have checked his name tag, but he wasn't wearing one. His professionalism was nonexistent and he should be reprimanded. To be a server he should have some customer service skills, but he had none at all and was very disrespectful.

We LOVE this place! It is our absolute go-to for a burger! My husband always does the DIY burger, but I stick to the Goat. We almost always order the pretzel sticks as well - get the cheese sauce too, you won't regret it! We've never had a bad experience, food and service is always upstanding!

I love everything about Morning Glory. They have the best biscuits and frittatas, and I'm obsessed with their red sauce which you can pour on basically anything. Their jam and pancakes are awesome too! The staff includes some of the nicest people in the city, and I always feel so welcomed when I get a chance to eat there. do not pass up grabbing brunch at this place if you are in the neighborhood!

I've been wanting to visit this place for about two months now and was finally able to go this past Tuesday. I ordered the spicy pork bulgogi and bulgogi kimbap. Both were amazing! I have been craving Korean food for a while and was really happy when I found Dosi Rak. The food tasted great and the serving was amazing for the price. I would definitely recommend. I plan on returning as soon as possible to try more of their dishes.

The best Mexican restaurant in Nashville! The steak fajitas with the special butter sauce is the best thing you will ever eat. I don't know what market value of guacamole is, maybe they could post that somewhere. The patio is great. There is limited free parking but lots of parking in the garage. Their chips and salsa are great and the mezcal skinny margarita is nice. I had a frozen margarita last time that was perfect on a warm summer night. This isn't just the best Mexican restaurant in Nashville it's way better than anything else.

If I could give negative stars then I definitely would!!!
I ordered almost a week ago through the App on Saturday. I waited about an hour and nothing. So I called and a women said that they only had two delivery drivers and that they were busy. I understood this so I  waited patiently. I hits 2 hours and still don't have my food. The women who answers now says they are down to one drive and that my order should be going out soon. By this time the store was closing.  I kept calling and luckily I was able to get someone who said my food would be coming. After waiting 4 HOURS, I just gave up and figured that i was not getting any food. 
The next day I call and ask to FINALLY have my food delivered and the person says they cant give out free food. Which I do not understand since i had already paid for it. She says i will have to talk to a manager and to call back after 6 pm. So i called back at 6:30 and they tell me that they are busy and to call back in about 30 min. SO i gave them time and called back and they still said the Manager was busy. So at this point i  told them something needs to happen and i want my food and or a refund.  
They said if they closed and my food wasn't delivered that my order would be cancelled and i would be issued a refund in 2-3 days.  So i had to put in another order in which i paid cash for and they forgot all the extra sauces that i was charged for. 
It has been almost a week and still no refund and everytime i call the store they say that the ma

Yo Sandra G, straight up came here and wrote a bad review like this is the Castaway in Burbank, CA or some shit... talkin about "no table service.." man you are mad that you are staring at yo own trash. 
The waiter I am sure will collect your TRASH after. 

Lady chill out, its a mom and pops chain like Denny's. 
No I don't work here, ignore her rude ass review. She probably tips 1% of her spendings.

Never had Ramen before(that wasn't in a package and microwaved). It was delicious! 
Cozy little place on Magazine street. Not a lot of seating but the staff kept things moving quickly. We were seated and served very timely. 
The food was big portions and more than we could eat. Love left overs. Must try the pork dumplings. So good. The ramen is served with chopsticks which is a challenge but you can get silverware if you want. 
The tastes are amazing. Can't wait to go back and try another bowl. 
Highly recommend.

Mint really is the great. Their prices are low and the food is so damn good. All the apps are good, I like the pork belly buns, egg rolls, bacon and crab rangoons, and shrimp and avocado rolls to name a few. The crispy hen is my go to dish and the lemon grass chicken bowl or baguette is my fall back.

Eaten here and had to-go a few times now and I'm a big fan. I love the Greek salad (although the olives are NOT pitted, which is my biggest complaint because I bit into a pit and that makes me so mad) and the salad dressing is "meh" but that doesn't matter because there's so much on the salad you don't need the dressing. Or just get their killer tzaziki. No joke, this salad will make you feel sick from over eating (and really, that's a huge compliment). 

The gyro platter/meat is great. I like to add it to my salad, although there is a Gyro Salad option (but I always want the potato salad). 

My husband doesn't always understand that you have to order right. So, like, he ordered the Cuban sandwich here once and hated it. But, that's not really the right thing to order at a Greek/Italian restaurant (even if the Cuban sandwich is part Italian inspired). He ordered the Italian panini most recently and he liked it a lot better although he wanted more lettuce. 

Their fries are good, not spectacular, but solid. They don't travel well to-go, but most fries don't so not gonna blame them for that. 

My mom has had their traditional Greek salad (it has a Greek name and I can't look it up while I type this but it's chunky with cucumbers and stuff, not lettuce-y) and she DEVOURED it. She said it was just like what she had every day of her trip to Greece last year. 

The Greek lemon soup was decent, but not amazing. My husband makes better it so neither of us would order that again. But

We love going to double dogs for a casual happy hour drinks and dinner. Their deals for HH are so good - we've gotten two entrees and four drinks total for under $50! Their food is consistently good, though keep it mind it's classic bar restaurant food, we always enjoy it either way. The staff has always been friendly as well, and we appreciate the table separation and mask requirements on the door so dining during Covid feels suitable for the times

Terrible service , waitress constantly kept disappearing, her name was Francesca I believe. Took forever to take our order. Food was subpar, not much flavor either for brunch. Not the best experience coming to whiskey cake when I have been here before and had a great time at dinner. Brunch is not good here. Bar tender outside was also very slow and dismissive to those coming up to the bar.

Hedge Row - a cute restaurant with patio at the corner of Alabama St and Vermont St in the Mass Ave area. I'd walked by this restaurant a couple of times and finally decided to call in for a reservation for Saturday night. They were only taking reservations for indoor dining while outdoor seating is by availability. We were greeted by a polite server who walked us through the menu, offered to answer any questions and gave us time to think about our order instead of rushing us. We started with spiced hummus that comes with fresh veggies and lavash bread. When I say fresh, I sincerely mean fresh. They're a farm-to-table concept restaurant so all ingredients looked as fresh as they possibly could. The server asked about any food allergies, which not many servers do, so I was quite impressed by that. For entrée, I got a spicy piri piri chicken sandwich - grilled, seasoned chicken breast served in a ciabatta bun. It was delicious! It came with fries and their garlic fries are simply awesome!!! The staff is very friendly and dedicated to providing great service. Definitely going back to try their fish lettuce tacos!

We stop in at Midway every time we visit Nola. The pizza and flatbreads are really good. Boyfriend and I also love their salads. He does beer and I do cocktails, and boy they make a mean Pimms Cup, ahh mama, so good. This is for sure our go-to joint and we dig this part of town, too, kinda artsy. Thumbs up, for sure!
Gosh! this place was delicious! I really enjoyed my meal and they had a great atmosphere as well!! If you're in the area I'd definitely recommend giving this place a shot.

This place is awesome! Came here after a long bike ride to get some vegan eats before biking home. The lady and gentleman who helped me were so nice and welcoming. I really enjoyed the beans that were on the specials board and the vegan sweet potato pie. There was a big basket of dollar protein bars, too! We sat outside- there is one table right out front, so it's more of a grab and go situation. Definitely recommend!
Great food! We love the Bbq chicken pizza it is so tasty! We always have the garlic knots and they are always super hot and delicious. Quick and super fast deliver!

We tried this place in addition to Café Dumond and they are both very good. I prefer café Dumond as they are a little more fluffy and light. These were very good though as they are a little crispier and delicious as well. A small glass of milk was almost 5 bucks. Seems a bit extreme. But the beignets were very good.

This review is for the food alone. I would give 4~5 stars for the excellent service at a heartbeat. 

I made a reservation for dinner at 6 last night and arrived 10 minute early. We were seated right away and menu and water were brought promptly. The ambience was great, hip and contemporary. It would work for casual meeting with friends or family but also for dinner date without feeling stuffy. 

My partner and I ordered edamame, sushi & sashimi combo for 2, and a sapporo premium beer. Our main came with complimentary salad with carrot ginger dressing & miso soup for each. I loved the dressing and miso was mild and not too salty, which was perfect.

Edamame appetizer was nicely salted and generous in portion. We ended up packing up the leftover and ate as a late night snack that evening. 

Sushi/Sashimi: First, portion is super generous. Especially with soup and salad, we were struggling to finish toward the end. Fish used for nigiri and sashimi probably weren't the best and it is understandable given the affordable price point. Both of us are frequent sushi eaters and have tasted lots of sushi from supermarket packaged rolls to high end venue in Manhattan and even in Japan, and surprisingly, we really enjoyed...california rolls of all things offered in this combo. They were generously rolled in lots of tobiko and well prepared. And shrimp tempura rolls. 

In the end, our entire meal plus taxes and tips came out to be a little over $80 and the bottom line is, Fat Salmon is a

If you're looking for a small, local coffee shop with solid options, look no further. I immediately felt at home when I walked through the doors of Santa Barbara Roasting Company. There were students doing homework, locals reading books, and friends catching up over a cup or two of coffee. I ordered the latte and was pleasantly surprised. The size of the cup as well as the quality of the latte were impressive and the relaxed atmosphere was perfect for doing work without feeling like I was in an office space.

Had delivery that was 45" after promised. Food cold.  What not do that again 
Food tasty when reheated

The service and the food were great. Not the typical Peruvian food I'm used to but definitely delicious.  I throughly enjoyed the plantains and dip they provide while you wait; I think we enjoyed 3 servings.
Always a treat, table side service is always impressive. Steak cooked to my liking and the manhattans are crisp and smooth.

I have never eaten here. Only picked up an order for doordash. The lady at the front counter was very rude when i walked in the door, and then proceeded to be even more rude when i was doing my job and checking the bag to make sure the order was right. When i asked her what something in the bag was, for my validation, she said "the customer will know" i love sushi and the food looked and smelled delicious, but i personally will never eat here because of the extremely rude staff member i encountered today.
Line moves along well, even if it looks daunting. Had 2 people working orders for drive up. There's a mobile app for pick up and in-person orders which went smooth. Loved the peppermint chip shake!

I have ordered here many times now and their sushi quality is really good.  I went to japan last year and the sushi here is the best quality I can get, it is on the same level as authentic japanese sushi.  The people who work there are also friendly, I would recomend this restaurant.

The service my family and I had was horrible. We waited for our drinks 25 minutes our server was rude, and to top it off the burgers we ordered were cold, and the restrooms were filthy. This is unacceptable for a chain like Red Robbin and a location that is fairly new.

Slim and husky's is not your typical "design your own" pizza joint. From the topping and sauce choices - to the local selection of beers on tap - to the ambiance, this place has it! They also have about 20 different sauces to choose from to drizzle or dip your pizza in. I've had several different combinations of pizzas and every one has been a winner. If you're more interested in a night in with your pizza, call in an order to The Roll Out across the street and grab some amazing cinnamon rolls while you wait. The only reason I took a star away is for the space---if you're there when it's busy, you know. There's not really a place to stand to wait for your pizza, especially if there's nowhere to sit. That still won't keep me from lining up at the door every time I'm in the mood for pizza.
Everything is good here but you need to get the south Philly cheesesteak pizza. It's incredible. Also their chicken fingers are the bomb.

$1.00 all day taco Tuesdays, where ya at? Hello, hi, here at El Patron. Now I honestly wished I came with an empty stomach. Initially, I came along for the drinks but the prices for the tacos got the best of me. Darn my cheapness. Taco prices nowadays aren't what they use to be and even when there are deals for tacos, it is very limited to usually chicken or ground beef. But here, you can opt for the traditional tacos with any protein of your choice including al pastor and lengua, both which I ended up getting. The lengua, cow tongue, was tender and had a texture that I enjoyed. I knew I would love the al pastor but wished it was topped with pineapple, my personal preference. 
Along with the tacos, the artichoke cheese dip was sort of a spectacular display for an appetizer. Its brought to you in a hot stone pot with the cheese gooey and bubbly. By the time you empty the bowl, remnants of burnt cheese is left. What a site.
Let's not forget margaritas are synonymous with tacos. You can't taco bout a taco party without margaritas. I would say the margarita pitcher served one and a half glass each between 3.

I've been to several Flap Jack's locations. They are all pretty similar especially in menu items. This one was pretty good. Our server was nice & quick. Our orders were accurate. The bathroom was a little messy.

I fly to Philadelphia and stop by here every time. The cheesesteaks are amazing. The customer service is always on point. I call in my order and it is ready when they say it will be ready. It is spotless in there. Love this place better than the commercial places. I have ordered different cheesesteaks and they are all good. The mushroom cheesesteak is may favorite this month.

The fries here are really good with their aioli. The burger would have been amazing but they didn't cook it to my liking. I asked for some pink & it was cooked all the way through. They also don't have ranch. My mom is a plainer eater & doesn't want to dip her fries in chipotle aioli. She wants ranch. What place in the midwest doesn't have ranch?
Love the atmosphere and rooftop setting here! Popped in on a Friday night around 10. Wanted to enjoy a couple drinks and some churros but no one ever greeted my group. :(

Downtown Nashville doesn't have many places that a local would be comfortable going to, but this is definitely one of them. I've had the burger two times and both were great. The bar is a good spot for a quick and relaxed drink before a show at Schermerhorn or a Preds game. Slightly pricy, but it is quality.

A refreshing addition to the Nashville food scene. It was a beautiful atmosphere and the food was recognizable yet delicious! We had the calamari and the Brussel sprouts.  I look forward to going back!

If you like crappy 'American' Mexicanish food, this is THE place. The 'salsa' was obviously out of a jar from the cheapest local American grocery store around the corner. Or maybe they just smash Tomatoes in the back room. Want guac? This was light green so it remotely resembled guacamole but other than that, tasted more like nothing. How can something taste like nothing? How did they accomplish this?

I ordered a 'plate' with chili relleno, cheese enchilada with rice and beans. 

The last time I had this version of this horrible rice I thought I was going to explode within the hour. It's what I ended up eating the most, bc the rest was going to take some nerve to eat so I had to build up nerve, and thought surely the rice was safe but I ate maybe half a cup. Holy mackerel this stuff expands in your stomach so badly that within the hour it was like eating a thanksgiving meal, and not the good kind. 

The sauce on the 'enchilada' was sweetened!!!  When do they put sugar in sauce??. I ate maybe 3 bites each of the cheese enchilada and chili thing but it was a struggle. How do they get away with feeding this slop to people??  And no one protests??!! 

This experience affected me so badly I had to go home and get in a fetal position because that's what the bomb in my stomach that was growing into the rock in my intestines. 

By morning, I was in deep regret. 


So, my summary: don't bother, in fact, just hit the Chick-Fil-A. 
Get over to Nolensville, (and not Hacienda) for real M
Had a nice experience during COVID. They were practicing appropriate guidelines to make my wife and I feel safe. Food and service were great. Will return and recommend to others.
Great place we tried due to most things closing at 9. WS not disappointed wine and food was great. Kid friendly was a plus.
Great food, quick and friendly service. Covered outdoor dining, a great place to enjoy a meal.
Extremely expensive and not worth it. The management and service are just chaotic! Also they claim that they have the most authentic hotpot, which I don't really think so.

I love coming here because the staff is so accommodating and passionate about their menu. My go-to is the tuna salad salad which is the best I've had just about anywhere. 

Make sure to save some time to browse all of the UK goodies in their shop! It makes me nostalgic for my trips to London.
Delicious food! I love that they have vegan options. All the vegan dishes that I've had there are exceptionally good.

Horrendous service and poor quality food. I've ordered from this restaurant before, but I'm done giving them my business. I called to place an order and the woman on the phone answered "what do you want"... nothing from your restaurant, that's for sure. I don't understand why, considering the high competition in this area, you would think they'd try to provide better service. In any case, avoid this place.
Excellent breakfast! We were lucky to be there during fall when the apple specials were rolling around like bosses.

I know it's been a while since we have all had to interact with people, but the hostess was quite unfriendly. Tried calling for 45 minutes to place the order over the phone. Gave up and went to Pisces in person to place our order. There was 1 person in front of me placing an order. 2 other people came in behind me. I told the hostess that I needed to place an order as well. She ignored me and helped the 2 people who came in behind me with their pickup orders. Ok. I'm pretty chill, so I let it go. I ordered 12 rolls, 2 gyoza, 1 edamame and 8 salmon nigiri. My order was already written down before I walked in the door since I had tried to call in my order. We were told our order would be ready in 20-25 minutes. I paid and tipped well. We waited in the parking lot. After 30 minutes, I went in to check my order status. I was told that it was a "huge order" and wasn't ready. I watched people who came in after me and ordered 4 or 8 rolls pick up their order and stroll away. We finally received our sushi after 55 minutes - not 25 minutes. The good news is that the sushi was quite good. Will I wait again for an hour for a to-go order from here and have to deal with a rude hostess? Probably not.

I go to this restaurant all the time with my dad, and we love it here! The service is great, but the food is the star of the show. One of my favorite dishes here is the alambre which has amazing flavors and comes with rice & beans. All of the flavors here are incredible. The chips they give you for free at the beginning are fantastic! Another favorite of mine is sopes. The flavor and textures are both perfect. You must try this restaurant if you're in the area!

Looking for takeout food, after a delayed flight- we were hungry, it was 10:30 Saturday night. Phoned the restaurant and was told the kitchen was open until midnight. We looked at their menu online, and called back to place order- phoned twice. Rang for, honestly, 5 min. Decided to drive there and place order. Walked in and no one at front desk. Music was deafening. After standing there a few minutes, a guy at a bar table walks over (maybe he just got done work there?) & tells me to order from bartender. She eventually walks over and I said I was trying to phone but no one answered. She said "The music's loud." Really? Strike one. 
 Then she asks me what I'd like and I said to order food (We wanted an antipasto and pizza). When I said "an antipasto..." she pivots around, looks at her register, turns back and says," We have a limited menu late night. We don't have pasta."  Either she was deafened by the music, or didn't know that antipasto is not pasta (I'm thinking the latter).  Strike two.  
Bottom line, I walked out. Will NEVER be back again, & Giuseppe's in Hatfield made us delicious food, with a smile, and won us as lifelong, loyal customers.

I had my bridal shower here in February 2020 and couldn't have been happier with the decision. I was choosing between multiple restaurants in the area, and ended up choosing Bulla for a few reasons: Lucy (who we worked with) was extremely responsive and helpful, they offered a semi private space, the menu and drink options were plentiful, the restaurant itself is sparkling clean, and we were allowed to bring in decorations. To be honest, we did go past our allotted time a bit, but the team at Bulla did not rush us out or make us feel unwelcome. I would highly recommend hosting a gathering of 30ish people at Bulla!

Huge Place with plenty of seating.
Food was good.
Highly recommend - Salmon !
We eat here on the reg. Wonderful nachos and great prices. Thank you for making great food!

We visited Buca on Saturday, May 11th, to celebrate our 4-year old daughter's birthday.   As soon as we received and paid our bill, the manager came to our table and told us gruffly that we would have to leave, that "our 2 hours were up and we'd been there a long time."

This was unwarranted for the following reasons:  1) The waitress didn't take our order for 45 minutes after we were seated, so we had barely finished our meal at this point at 2 hours;  2) We had been told that we had until 8:15pm, that's when the next reservation was scheduled (for reference, the manager asked us to leave at 7:30pm); 3) Staff had not been pre-busing the table or indicating they were planning to turn it quickly;  4) The manager approached us with contempt, acting as though we were somehow wrong for being there too long rather than with graciousness and hospitality we expect from restaurants like Buca; 5) We had made our reservation weeks in advance with ample notice of the size of our party and the fact that it was a celebration, so we should have been notified of any time limits in advance. 

The attitude of the manager was unacceptable. Most of our party had worked in the restaurant industry and we would have been more than understanding had we been approached respectfully about the need for our tables to seat another large waiting party. However, instead we were treated as if we were somehow loitering and causing a disturbance, after we were nothing but accommodating and understanding with
Great food for the price and delivery is always quick and accurate.  This is our go-to for chinese food when we're in a hurry and don't have time to pick up food.

This is a cute little cafe in the heart of Metairie. I have only been here once but would like to try more menu items. I went here for their hot cupcake latte. I also ordered a breakfast croissant. I really enjoyed the flavor of the coffee. It was not an overpowering cupcake flavor but tasty. Sort of like a slightly sweeter normal latte. The croissant was good but I was a little disappointed that it was flattened sort of like a panini. I was looking forward to a flaky  buttery croissant but it was still tasty. 

Everyone behind the counter was professional and I loved fresh, real flowers on most of the tables. There are about 8 small tables in the restaurant and a few outside so you can watch the clearview traffic and whatnot. 

I really liked that they sell booze. They sell mimosas and bloody Mary's even rum punches here. They have a breakfast and lunch dinner and I think you can both from open to close. I should have asked if they make Irish coffees here but with all the menu items and pick your flavor options, I am sure they would. 

Nice little gem in Metairie.

It's called a Duck House so of course we had to get the duck! We came in for an early Sunday lunch and were seated promptly. We were given complimentary hot tea.

We ordered the duck wonton noodle soup and the charsiu pork and roasted duck rice plate. Everything tasted delicious! The duck wonton noodle soup tasted rich and warm and the noodles were super soft. The wontons were plentiful as well. 

As for the charsiu and roasted duck rice plate, this hit the spot. The charsiu pork and duck were perfectly cooked and seasoned. The duck skin was glistening and crispy and had a ton of meat. The rice plate also had some Chinese broccoli. 

We saw another table get the duck roll so we also got that but I wouldn't recommend it since it's about almost half the price of a 1/4 duck plate. It was good, but I wished it had more veggies in it... It just wasn't worth it in my opinion.

I would highly recommend getting any of the duck dishes and maybe a side order of just the duck! The duck is so meaty and cooked to perfection, you won't be disappointed!

J&K came highly recommended by my parents, so when I needed a break I headed there for lunch.  I called in my order and it took about 20 minutes to be ready.  The food was only ok, I don't need to go back.  They have a nice little seafood shop, I'd go back for that.
Food is always good and fresh. Love the atmosphere. Had the shrimp and lobster roll with the potato salad. I admit to being a potato salad snob, and theirs was amazing!

If you're hungry or want a dessert at a late time around from night until 12 in the morning I would recommend this place. They have fast service and fresh ready food! Our waiter was fast and very polite to us even though it was literally 12 in the morning.
This place is great for take away or a quick bite. Not much room in the dining area but very clean. Gets crowded at lunchtime. Women's bathroom is very clean.

Understaffed and under qualified. Ruined my food then brought back less food then the first time. Tried to talk to the chef instead they brought the girl working the register which had 10 people in line waiting. I'm sure on their lunch break as well. All around frustrated with the whole situation. Will not recommend and will not be coming back. Lost more then half of my lunch break to this nonsense. The food was terrible as well.

This particular store does Not,need to be open during this Crisis!!!
The Staff is Extremely Rude and treat everyone as if they are all Diseased!!
When I received my Order, the Bag was too Small and tore open,that's when they gave me the Correct bag with Handles
Pretty much every time I order food from this place they mess up the order. Always check your bag before you leave the restaurant!
It was awesome!!! Shakes are so good - neopolitan is the way to go. Long line as always but they move things along efficiently.

Do to my Retirement Community's  Stay in Place restriction I have not "eaten out" in more than five weeks (probably the longest in my long life).  I wasn't looking forward to spending my 85th birthday with no special dishes.  My son contacted Manny's and they delivered enough food for a three-day breakfast celebration.  Since "outsiders" are prohibited from coming into the buildings delivery entailed checking at the Guard House and then driving to a designated drop-off area.  They even included a "Happy Birthday" Wish.
Oh - the food!  Delicious Bagels, bacon done just right (cooked through but not dry), great lox.

Let me tell you, Magdalena's Pizzeria was truly fabulous. The menu is pretty extensive so will probably be back to try some of the other items. I am going to tell all my friends to try their Supreme, it was just amazing. Crew is extremely friendly and definitely will help you with everything. You will really like Magdalena's Pizzeria.

Dry fries
Slow service
Small portions
This place is definitely not what people hype it up to be. Just another corporate burger
Lots of better options in town

I was visiting from out of town for the night and decided to make a reservation at Ciro's. I've been here before during Covid and the experience was amazing. This time around not so much. I called the same day to see if they had any cancellations on booths and they happened to have one at 7:30pm, so I moved my existing reservation of a high top to a booth. Unfortunately, when we arrived we were seated in an open area booth infront of the bar instead of the private ones. I wish we would've been advised of this beforehand. Around 8:30-9pm the bar was packed! You couldn't even get up from the table and go to the bathroom without having to push and shove to get through. This experience wasn't enjoyable considering it's a speakeasy and they are so picky with reservations. I assume the restrictions with covid have diminished. I was even told I couldn't make a reservation for 3 people but you could make a reservation for 4....doesn't make sense and the people sitting in front of us were a group of 3. Also we ordered a second round of drinks that took over 25 minutes to receive and then while drinking them we were told we had to leave our table because the next party was already there. Please note our 2 hours were not even up yet! And they kicked us out first rather then the drunk party in front of us that were walk-ins and had no reservations.

Super friendly staff. We have been a couple of times and taken our kids as well. The chorus of "Yums" starts at the appetizers and continues into our variety of orders. Most of our family love the usual Chinese fare General Tso Chicken, orange beef, Kung pao Chicken, and my favorite Shrimp Fantasia. Great atmosphere. We will be back!!!

Bring some cash and expect a wait, but they are a solid place for pizza. Luckily when I went (before the pandemic), there was not a huge line. We waited for about 15 minutes to order and then another 15-20 to get our grandma pie. 

We ate half the pizza together in one sitting, and honestly, we probably could've downed the whole thing right there. The dough was thin but held up nicely, the cheese was fresh and plentiful, but what impressed me the most was their tomato sauce. I've never been someone who eats pizza for the tomato pie experience, but this tomato sauce was flavorful and fresh - a component that I will definitely consider more in other pizzas from now on.

If you're looking for a quality thin crust, authentic pizza experience, I'd recommend coming here.
Always an excellent experience, got the shredded pork in Garlic Sauce and it was fabulous

Under staffed for a Tuesday night. After waiting about 10 minutes, we had  to track down a waitress and then waited another 10 minutes to get our drinks. Beef taco very bland  and chicken was just ok. McCormick taco seasoning has better seasoning. Won't be back for Taco Tuesday.
Not really a fan of the service . Waiter was hard to get a hold of . Salad was rather soggy . Overall I was expecting more since friends recommended it. Would likely not come back.

What can I say about Cracker Barrel? It's a glorified diner with a theme of old style country cooking. I generally have pancakes or meatloaf, which are both pretty good. I really go for the cornbread and biscuits. I usually have 4 of each so by the time we get home I'm in a carb coma. It's worth trying if you want something different than a standard diner. Their country store is adorable offering country-themed holiday decorations,  doo-dads and old fashioned candy.

I gave up on this location a couple years ago, but gave it a shot today. The tenders were not tenders at all, but more like big chicken nuggets, just looked and had the consistency of being ran though a food processor and then molded. Is this something new for Popeyes? They were pretty bad. Great fries and great friendly employees, but I didn't want large McNuggets.

Loved everything we tried here. The charcuterie board, dumplings, pasta, wings, and braised short ribs were all amazing. Absolutely enjoyed our cocktails! Definitely coming back again, and can't wait to experience this place post pandemic.

Also, did not realize this when my friends and I picked this place to eat, but the head chef was a Chopped Champion and on Hell's Kitchen. We only found out because she was shooting a promo video for some event they were going participating in. Explains a lot about the food quality.

Visiting from Seattle and lucky to find the Seahawks on!! Fun atmosphere, with an amazing staff of friendly, attentive people. It was so aqesome to see the ladies there working so hard and as a team. Great pork chop! Would definitely come back!!

Bang for your buck: 9/10
Quality: 10/10
Service: 10/10
Ambiance/Location: 9/10
Overall: 10/10


When we were in Nashville, we didn't have a Shake Shack at home yet, so while this may not be on everyone's Nashville eats list, we knew we couldn't head home without getting a delicious burger.

This location didn't disappoint. The food was as wonderful as you'd expect from a Shake Shack. The service was friendly and efficient. The restaurant was absolutely spotless! 

Our only critique is the parking and the efficiency of the line. This location is located in a really cute little outdoor mall, but that meant a lot of the parking was designated for another store or concept. It took us circling for a bit to find a spot. If you're local, this likely will not befuddle you as much as it did us. 

After finishing our meal, we wanted to grab a shake (because, Shake Shack shakes cannot be missed!). Getting back in line to place our dessert order though meant actually having to go outside and come back in to be in the line due to the way it was roped off. Not a big deal, but definitely awkward. I'd go out and come back in for Shake Shack any day though!

I ordered the charnita tacos and they were disgusting! In the meat were rubbery fatty pieces, I almost thought it was pig ears! I've had the same tacos at a lot of different places and it was never like that! I would never order from there again! I was so disgusted and had to throw a away my whole order

I got a large sushi order for my family of 5. The restaurant was prompt with completing the order and everything was packed by the time I come to pick it up. The sushi rolls are placed beautifully on a tray with soy sauce, Wasabi and ginger packed separately.
Taste-wise, everything was okay. While not the best sushi I've had and the tempura pieces tasted not as fresh, for the price, this was unbeatable. They have so many options and a lot of special rolls. They have 50% off sushi which makes this the cheapest sushi place I've seen. As far as I know, this deal is not on any of the food delivery app and you have to call the restaurant directly to order. 
This place unfortunately is too far to deliver to my house, because had it been closer, I would order more often.

Arrived at the same time as 2 other couples. We all ordered around the same time. One couple ordered, got their food, ate, paid, left and we still didn't get out food. The waitress never came to apologize or let us know what was happening. After almost an hour of waiting we just decided to get it to go. We've been here before and the food is good, but the service was poor. We understand COVID has made things crazy, but waiting almost an hour for food without anyone checking in with us is completely unacceptable and unprofessional. Debated writing this review but we left so upset i had to post it. When we left with out food, the other couple we arrived with STILL hadn't gotten their food.

Falafel Time is a great neighborhood Mediterranean restaurant.  Their falafel sandwich's are really good.  Fresh ingredients and hot falafels.  Great combination!  Their prices are reasonable about $11.  It's a small place but great quality food and friendly staff!  I go back on a regular basis.  A must try if you like falafels!
If I'm paying $5 for chips and queso the least you can do is fill the cup up to the top. Is that too much to ask for when spending money on fast food?

This is THE place to come in New Orleans for coffee and beignets.  You might be drawn to the far more famous Cafe du Monde but the beignets are simply superior here and the atmosphere is far more relaxed and leisurely than the touristy hectic energy at du Monde.  This is also a great spot for breakfast; I recommend the crawfish omelet and grits or the hash browns (really it's a fried potato hash but still delicious despite the confusing name).  Coffee is delicious; go for a traditional cafe au lait with those yummy beignets.  You'll always find warm and gracious southern hospitality here, too.

I didn't know "Craft BBQ" was a thing but Beast made me a convert. We had beef ribs and fries and smoked cauliflower. All good with tasty bbq and dipping sauces. I didn't have room to try the "sprouts and belly" or the bread pudding. Will have to try next time though.

Enjoyed a great Sunday dinner at Enoteca Tredici.  Small plates were shared by all, favorites were the Bacon Wrapped Dates and Moroccan Spice Ribs - both spectacular.  Broccoli and Avocado was a nice complement.  Excellent space with upscale, interesting decor.  A five-star rating was surely in the bag... until a little research showed the $64/bottle Pinot Noir, highly recommended by the otherwise excellent server, was merely a decent wine that we found sells locally for about $12 - a markup of over 5X is Main Line robbery.  Other wine was also somewhat overpriced but not as much as our pinot. We will most definitely be back but it'll be beer and cocktails - both appeared reasonably priced.

When the French Quarter was crowded on a major holiday, this restaurant was able to seat a party of 7 within 5 minutes. In addition, the waitress was easily able to split checks with no qualms whatsoever. We were also able to use a yelp coupon on an appetizer, and the server was extremely accommodating. The drinks were fairly expensive but delicious, and our spinach and artichoke dip appetizer was absolutely amazing! 2 people in our party ordered the dip as their main entree after we tried it as an appetizer.
For entrees, we ordered shrimp po' boys, red beans and rice, more spinach and artichoke dip, and Alfredo pasta. All our food was to die for! The only complaint was that the pasta was cold, but management was quick to heat up the plate and apologize profusely.
All in all, this was a fantastic dining experience that I would recommend to anyone visiting the French Quarter.

For 20 years I've had a consistently GOLDEN experience at this restaurant. They're not a "DRAGON" my budget - it's always a great value. 
Plus the fortune cookies accurately predict the future. Today my fortune said, "Eat at Golden Dragon often, you will like the food & experience."

Very nice, relaxed place for breakfast. Benedict perfect, omelette great. I know my review is short but sometimes no need to extrapolate on goodness. Do go, won't regret it.
Service us wonderful and attentive, prices normal for breakfast. Close to downtown.
Food was Amazing. Especially the appetizer scallops! If you are looking for a white wine to pair with your seafood, I highly recommend the Stella pinot grigio. It was light and refreshing.

I love buffalo wings but this bar is so dirty every time I come now. Menus just thrown on the bar, dishes not bussed, trash not thrown away. I came here AT LEAST once a week (because of the old bartender) now it just went down hill. Some days I come in and I have to move dishes out the way to sit and I have to look at those dirty dishes the entire meal...honestly come on. Then she never stays behind the bar, always in the back. If she is behind the bar she is on the phone or talking to other people that are not paying (family or coworkers). She is really nice when you communicate with you but too many other faults ruins all the other. Only give two stars because I still love the food...
When I walked in it was so beautiful.  The food was delicious. And the staff was so sweet. If your looking for good thia food this is the place to go

Walking by this place you probably wouldn't give it a second look but the mystery was too intriguing to not give it a shot. Friends and I ordered chorizo burrito and the nachos which came quick and still hot. The burrito was HUGE and absolutely delicious and messy but wouldn't want Mexican food any other way. Nachos were fresh and yummy. Definitely will eat again.
Great Place! Excellent food. Loved the Grouper. Kids enjoyed it. Great service. Waitress was awesome. Loved it

Such a treasure!  Beautiful drive up the mountain to Cold Spring Tavern.  Parking is on the side of the road.  Tables are about 6 feet apart and they clean every time someone leaves.  Bathroom is very clean with sanitizer outside.  Food was excellent!  Ordered the tri tip sandwich which comes with 3 sauces.  I tried all3, but the horseradish was best! Had the chili for a side.  It was good. My son ordered the bison burger and it was very juicy, nice bun.  Substituted the onion rings for an additional $2.00.  They were fantastic!!!  Every one that works there was friendly and helpful.  Awesome spot for every age
Consistently good food even with the recent shutdown of restaurants except for takeout. Everyone working there is pleasant and accommodating.

Came to ChinaTown for SangKee and they were closed when I was going towards Halal Guys spotted this joint and decided to stop in,I ordered Spicy Pork Soup Dumplings & Shanghai Dumpling Soup aka wonton wrappers in broth no meat the broth was light & bland seaweed not bok Choy. But the Soup Dumplings are something that I am already planning to have again this week they were perfect, I wish I ordered 2 orders so we didn't have to share, I haven't had a dumpling that good since I was in Cali a few years back.
Worst FSU game watching site.  DJ would rather play crap music vs have the sound on for the game.  If you're going to commit to FSU for games, especially as an Alum, get your staff right.
Amazing !!!! Great staff awesome subs.  Great flavor and always fresh.  We make it a point to go here often.
I ordered on line and picked up 2 pizza,  Brooklyn  and combination pizza. Combination pizza was good, but Brooklyn pizza was bad.  It was almost $40 for 2 pizza.  Very pricey for just 2 pizza

This place is so bizarre and so New Orleans. It's a mish-mosh of overpriced groceries, festival trinkets, a deli, a pizza shop, and - supposedly - a laundromat upstairs. It's open 24 hrs.

For awhile after I moved to the neighborhood, I wrote this place off. But then I started trying the deli items. They're expensive. But... Some of the food and desserts are delicious. Now I've discovered the soups. I've tried a couple vegetarian soups and they are the BOMB!

I did finally try the pizza (it's only available sometimes) and it was probably the third best pizza I've had in New Orleans. That's not saying much, but I'm a Chicago pizza snob and found this really good. The crust is made with cornmeal, which is a key win.

Did I mention it's 24/7?

Had a great experience at this location. I called ahead with a large to-go order and arrived 15 min earlier than I (and they) expected. They were still preparing my order when I arrived and picked up the pace to get it completed quickly. Some of the muffins weren't quite finished baking but they offered an excellent substitution and got me on way. They were friendly and professional throughout and showed great hustle on a busy morning. This is a great team of employees!

I am pleasantly surprised by how good this place is. I was expecting the same type of gloopy flavorless food as ginger wok across town. It was definitely better than that restaurant. I got the homemade bean curd lunch. It's a spicy fried tofu in sauce with vegetables. The asparagus in the veggie mix was a nice change from other Chinese-american restaurants. It did advertise that it was spicy and it was not spicy at all. The flavor was alright. The sauce was a little oily but at least it wasn't gloopy. The egg drop soup is really fresh and they don't thicken it with a ton of corn starch. I like this y egg drop soup. My one complaint is that there was no fortune cookie and I got a set of different sauce but no fried wonton chips to go with it. Seems like they are being cheap in some areas while still being more expensive than most other Chinese-american places in the area.
Yen Ching is a Boise icon and one of the longest serving restaurants in town. The food and service is great.

First time ever visiting Panera and boy was I impressed.
Sure, it's a chain but the selection was pretty darn good.
My guy was feeling a bit under the weather so soup was on the radar last night.
They serve soup, sandwiches, desserts,  bread, and a few pasta dishes .
I found two options of soup for me ,vegetable or creamy tomato. I went with the creamy tomato and my guy ordered chicken soup.  It cane with a side, so we got slice of baguette , a drink and added a chocolate chip cookie.
Now, mind you we're in the middle of the Covid-19 and the restaurant was a bit empty but it was cozy 
Our food came to the table in a timely manner.
My surprise was the soup was hot. Not lukewarm but HOT! Yessssssss!
Oh.Em.Gee! Tasty, creamy, hot deliciousness in a bowl. Both of us were practically oh-ing and ah-ing as we guzzled it down. 
This was actually the first time he beat me eating! LOL, no conversation from his side of the table. No slurps but lots of Mmmm's from us both.
The cookies? Melt in your mouth. We got there around 6 p.m. so the oatmeal raisin cookies were gone, his favorite.  The chocolate chip ones were tasty and completed the meal.
Why have we never been to Panera? Well, I can say we will be back! I have other items to try.
Served an impressive size delicious veggie calzone along with fried calamari that would bring me back to dine again.

2 hour food tour in Tampa continues with the best empanadas in Tampa. This is stop number 2 and I always order some chicken ones for hubby and I crave the spinach ones.

Definitely recommend to request some chimichurri sauce for dipping and have the empanadas packed in a paper bag. The plastic containers will make soggy since the treats are warm.

Love the Latin atmosphere that reminds me of Miami and it is a great place for an afternoon cafe and dessert too!
! Hasta la vista, amigos!!
Very good and fresh tasting. Good pricing and great salsa! I love the enchiladas and rice!

Limited eating menu on the rooftop, not the cheapest place in town. The best thing is the view on the rooftop where the railing is much more accessible for seating while having a drink. Most places with rooftop bars you cannot see comfortably over the railing. Live music was good. We hung out for an afternoon drink to kill some time. Not too crowded on a week day. Love the tractor bar downstairs! And there is also live iHeartRadio studio and a gift shop within the restaurant which is pretty cool. Also, for price exploring purposes, my captain and sprite was $12 whereas most other places are $10 or less.
They shut down the bar before midnight last night. 11pm for last call was ridiculous! This is not what guests expect!
take-out was packaged perfect so no leaks. tasted so delicious. picked-up and it stayed hot well past me getting to my destination.

avoid at all costs...
Not as fresh as other places around here.. go to Arigato, Sushi Teri, or even Sushi Tyme (basically any other sushi place downtown)
we had to send back the spicy tuna for being way too old (and the staff was laughing at us) and my spider roll was not good at all. The sushi is all cut unevenly. Dont give your money to a business that doesnt care enough to provide fresh food.
        
I have no idea how they manage to pay their rent on state street..

My wife and I really enjoy this restaurant. Very tasty food, very pleasant staff, and a nice atmosphere. I've had the pleasure of trying multiple dishes here, and everything has been delicious. I highly recommend Bluefin to anyone looking for some form of Asian cuisine.
We waited 30 minutes for Burgers- gave our food to somebody else. Over cooked the Black and Buel Burger- Owner then came out and said it was the best he could do. - Would not recommend!!

I met a friend here for dinner and we both LOVED it! I got the fig and pear pizza which was amazing and so flavorful. The crumbled bacon perfectly complemented the sweetness of the fig and pear toppings. I took a few slices home and had them for lunch the next day. The tiny soup sampler they give you is also delicious, and I might try that next time I come. They also have a great drink selection, offering many beers from local breweries. We came on a rainy weeknight, and while I had a reservation, I probably didn't need one. Definitely recommend The Couch Tomato if you want a cozy place to grab a bite!

I wish I could say I had a great meal here tonight before a show at the Met. However we were never seated. Despite having a 6:30 reservation, we left at 7:05 since we had concert tickets for 8pm. A restaurant of this caliber which had been around for over a decade should be better equipped to take reservations that they can keep. Pretty lame.

BrickTop's has the most wonderful, consistent food and service. The restaurant is always immaculate and they are very professional regarding COVID safety practices.  But my favorite part is the whole experience it's like a mini vacation! The atmosphere feels so relaxed, hippy and fun. It's our favorite go to in this area!
Good atmosphere, great presentation but the sushi had no flavor. We ordered 6 different rolls and none of them had flavor. The crab rangoons were very good but cold inside. Definitely won't be back.

We checked this place out because of the good reviews and tried the Classic Pepperoni Pizza to get a feel for the place. I will definitely be coming back to try more of their selection, because the pizza was amazing. The sauce was amazing and the dough was to die for!

This might very well be my favorite Mexican restaurant of all time!

The food is fresh and the portions are generous. As stated by others, they serve you a couple of gorditas instead of chips and I am physically addicted to them by now!

First time out I tried the fajitas and as usual, I ran out of tortillas! Typically, when this happens there's enough meat and vegetables to possibly roll one or two more "tacos". In this case, there was probably enough to roll three or four more!

On my second visit, I tried the fajita burrito for lunch and it was perfect!

My last meal here was a platter of chicken nachos that were the way I love them. Layered with beans, meat and the jack/cheddar shredded cheese melted on top as opposed to that melted crap most places pour on top. Even the chips on bottom stayed crisp and hot!

On the downside, my wife ordered a diet coke all three times. There is no fountain, so it comes in a can. The price was $3.40 and obviously no refills. I don't mind paying a little more for good food, but the soft drink price was ridiculous.

So I see my son already put in a review of our visit today. While I agree with everything he said I'd like to add this small piece. While we were at the front trying to pay and get the heck out of there we had our waitress arguing with us. She kept repeating it's not my fault as if this made everything ok. I replied if you had communicated with us it would've helped. I also said while she was arguing in front of a crowd of people excuse me but I'm the customer. I also didn't appreciate her putting up her finger to me with an angry look like I was a child being told to be quiet. On the whole it was a humiliating experience and something I haven't been through before and hopefully won't be again. While the food is good it's not that good to warrant that kind of treatment. I won't be returning obviously. Nell you might be better suited in another occupation.

Great service! 

Tried the sea bass for a change and it was perfect! Thanks Capital Grille for another great dinner!

Met up with an old friend for lunch on a Saturday, only my second time there even though I live right down the road.  The place was busy non-stop the entire time we were there.  Our waitress was great, food was delicious and I got my first magnet!!  Fun atmosphere!  I will be sure to go back and take my husband with.

Great fresh ingredients, vegan cheese options and GF break. Try a blackberry lemonade Mimosa, you won't regret it.
Replacing the space of Blue Bird with a sand which shop was a bold a dangerous move, but it has paned out!

My wife and I came in on Saturday Evening. It's definitely a cute little spot. The Service is super friendly and nice! They let us try some of their sauces before making a decision. Their mind eraser along with their sweet and sexy was my favorite. We were able to try some of the sauces before we made a decision. I had the tuna, my wife had the salmon and my sister in law had the shrimp. There was alot of rice in the bowl. The proteins had a small scoop in it. The tuna wasn't bad. I've definately had better at other places. The unlimited toppings were a huge plus. I loved that. The mango drink they had was really good and they were happy to accomodate for extra sauces. Overall it wasn't bad but then it wasn't completely stand out. I wish they would had balanced the protein a bit more with the rice. I definately felt like i had like 1/3 of the rice left by the time i finished eating my protein. The scoop size of the protein seemed really small. Overall wasnt bad. The Sauces were the best part of the bowl.

There is an abundance of outside seating and the inside seating is well spaced for social distancing.  We were there around 5:30 on a Tuesday and were seated immediately although it was between Thanksgiving and Christmas which we find is a slow time for this part of Florida.  I enjoyed the lobster pot pie which was very good and my wife had the lobster bisque (very good) and an ok  Cobb salad.  Our grand daughter had the fish and chips which she raved about.

Time and time again. I order through Doordash.  I have called too many times. STOP filling up the drinks with so much ice. I am tired of paying for ICE. What don't you people get. I have complained to your store and Doordash.  Nobody seems to get it. FIX THE PROBLEM.

The space is very nice and open. We went on a day where they had a party and it was in a separated space but still open. There's a play area for the kids and it's nice. There's the climbing/slide space, a seesaw thing, some kind of old carnival ride piece that the kids can open and get into (my girl's favorite space), video games on part of one wall. We sat outside to eat. The food was ok. 

I really like being able to go and sit and grab a drink while the kids play.

You absolutely cannot go wrong with anything on this menu! This is one of my favorite places for fine dining. Not to mention, the staff is consistently friendly. There is a particularly nice ambience that renders this restaurant a fantastic atmosphere for a romantic date or a relaxed evening with friends. The tempura artichoke, oysters, lamb, and calamari are all fantastic first courses and were loved among all of the guests I dined with. If you love olives, the calamari is an absolute must. The lamb is split with one half of the course topped with pepper relish and the other with chimichurri. I indulged in the gnocchi with scallops and shrimp, and I must admit that the scallops were some of the best- a light, flakey texture with a softness that melts in your mouth. The gnocchi itself does not actually contain any potato. Others I dined with ordered pork loin and steak. The pork loin was tender and rich with flavor, even if you do not ordinarily enjoy pork loin. The cake, the crème brulee, and the chocolate pot de creme were all phenomenal. The chocolate pot de creme is especially suited for those who do not typically enjoy super rich or sweet desserts. I will certainly be returning!

This food is anything but fresh. Everything was cold and the refried beans looked like they had sat in their container for a week. I've never been served cold queso before, but there's a first time for everything!

Our server was extremely kind and professional, and the place was clean and well decorated. To top that, the food was unbelievably delicious! I would definitely come back here. Super fun and fresh. GOETTA !!!

Went here on a Sunday at 12 noon for brunch and didn't have to wait 1 second! Their service was really quick, my husband loved their iced coffee (and he is a picky coffee drinker). I ordered the A.M. SUPERFOODS BOWL with coconut milk chia seed pudding (which was actually the best chia pudding I've ever had in my life) topped with fresh berries. They also served it with toast and almond butter (which was a perfect touch. I finished it all, without being too full. I asked for the preserves on the side & smeared that on the toast like a "pb & jelly." My husband ordered the traditional breakfast with a side of biscuits and gravy. Great price, clean atmosphere, delicious food, great staff. I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a yummy brunch.
Customer service was great in the drive thru and the beignets were soft warm and covered in powdered sugar SO GOOD!! One word of advice do NOT eat them in the car! lol

Greenwood offers $5.00 burgers on Friday . 
This location would not match, did not care to discuss. 
Will not return to this location

Carmen is still just a beautiful woman and a terrific waitress. She is as good as they come. What a delight.
Oh, and the bar-be-que ribs are fantastic!

I've been working in the area for over 2 years . Never seen cheaper food or a worst service and attitude from the worker than this place .Its supposed to be a breakfast brunch place . The home made fries supposed to be their signature plate , instead of taking their time and make it the right way .They use frozen fries , cut it in small pieces and burning it or using some old fries . Do not waist your money going there !

I was a bit disappointed when I got my food based on the amount of good reviews this place had. Everything was pretty mediocre. I ordered the hot cakes, the fried chicken sandwich, buffalo cauliflower, the front street eggs benedicts and the matcha mint chip smoothie. 

They didn't know how to package their food so by the time I got home with the food, everything was soggy. It shouldn't be airtight like that! 

The fried chicken sandwich was disappointing. I could tell that the oil they used was not fresh so the battered part of the chicken was dark and the chicken was dry. They probably fried it a bit too long for that to happen. 

The front st Benedict's was mediocre, pretty standard, nothing special about it. Hot cakes were mediocre too. 

I did love the buffalo cauliflower, however just know that when you order to go it's deconstructed! It was still tasty.

If I could give  10 stars I would.  4th time here & 4th time very pleased.  I was able to get the loaded hash browns with my sandwich.  It's to die for. Now just waiting for them to bring out the puffs.

Great local Pub, convenient to PHl.  Nice to be greeted by the owner who by the way bought a round.  Excellent food Nice to visit a pub that supports the community and appreciates customers during these trying times

Best Gumbo in New Orleans!!! That gumbo had me going back for more... Crawfish is fresh and delicious!!! I usually go to Castnet... but Cajun Shack has gained a loyal customer!!! Every item on menu is delicious from the meat pies to the broiled seafood to the burgers.  You can't go wrong at Cajun Shack!!!!

Service was great and the staff were very friendly. But as Jews, we couldn't endorse this deli as Jewish. We ordered pastrami with a shmear of chopped liver, half a tuna salad sandwich, a knish, and three pints of matzo ball soup. The tuna salad was good. The pastrami was overly salty but lacked any depth of flavor, and the knish was cold and dense (but with good potato filling.) But the worst was unfortunately the matzo ball soup- the broth was fine, but the matzo balls were a gluey, gummy mess. For 50 bucks, although everyone was very sweet to us, we can't recommend it. Stick to Lucky Dill.

Ordered online for first time due to Covid 19 and the food was piping hot and fresh! Staff all wearing masks and customers patiently waited at a social distance to pick up their orders. Best Thai food in town.

This is a great big brew pub that conjures up the warmth and comfort of a ski lodge or upscale fishing lodge. The award-winning suds are proprietary and tasty, covering every style of beer known to humanity. Regarding food, I've only had the salmon tacos, and they were beautifully prepared and plated. Nice, long bar with plenty of big screen TV's for Gameday, and beautiful mountain-scape art on the walls. Great place; will return often.
Always reliable and dependable. Happy Lunch Special is a great value and the money bag is really tasty. Service is also very friendly!

This place really knows what they're doing.  It was top-notch in all categories.  We went for our wedding anniversary, as they were so highly rated by Philadelphia magazine.  Now I understand why!  The pasta we ordered was homemade and absolutely delicious and unique with a lovely savory mushroom sauce.   Our salad was also unique with greens I had never seen before, but they were super fresh and delicious.  I must add that we have been to hundreds of fine restaurants in the U.S. as well as Europe and Japan, so we have had many experiences for comparison.  The most impressive dish was our whole Pocono trout that was the BEST fish I have ever eaten.  The waiter fileted it right at the table.  I have never eaten the skin before, but it was prepared so that you could enjoy it as well -- absolutely delicious.   It wasn't cheap, but seemed to be priced fairly for the high quality experience you are receiving.  Also, the proportions are generous and meant to be shared.  I just cannot wait to go back there again.

Went in and ordered takeout for lunch.

The lunch specials are HUGE, and include soup and a spring roll!  Lots of food!

The drunken noodles were great, and the red curry was the perfect heat!

Will order from them again when down in Ballwin!

We LOVED this place. What a great little gem! We were looking for a patio space on a Friday night that wasn't super crowded, I'm not sure how this place wasn't, but I wasn't going to complain.

Their whole indoor section is off limits and they're doing an awesome job of social distancing. Lucky for us, they had a Friday night tapping (I guess this is a regular thing!) so we got to try a Strawberry Kiwi beer which was awesome, and their other options were great as well. They had a wide variety to choose from which was perfect for us, I love sours so was stoked to see one on their menu.

The food was also delicious, I liked their small menu, but very specialized. You can see the guys making the food, it's extremely fresh. You HAVE to try the fried pretzel because I'm literally still dreaming about it.

This will definitely be a regular spot for us, affordable, great atmosphere, good beer - highly recommend.
Came out for drinks with a friend and we both thoroughly enjoyed our time. Servers were so friendly and attentive. The truffle fries were our favorite.
